# Independent review: table 13+1 source roles v3

Reviewed support patch SHA-256 `1d57c6874bc42beecb4be0340fb9f8061a6114850ff25f585f28c5d6aa9d4ba5`, current patch `9cc387482dc7a674cde46786a5263fe1ab6bbe71286e73c78858a90137c5b92c`, frozen patch `748f38cb3e22618fdcf3edb76c76902aa980ec14e4167aa59a4b169ef22914df`, and manifest `ae4f0dd0d9ad04fd2f74d49c2d8f4e1dd3cac2357f5d88d936a596fd24ecd60b`, at base `87d381f56b545081bfb87b1d5f1a1e1e9941d2eb`. Strict isolated apply generated all seven staged files exactly. No canonical writes or installation.

No blocking finding in bounded source-role continuation. The 13 current and one frozen selected rows preserve every field apart from their new source-review references; each new review embeds the exact complete prior row and review. Non-producer prior evidence is preserved, and each replaced producer reference is accompanied by its exact historical Git-byte data archive and the current producer reference. Both archived producers match commit `d705ef13767f65720ff10b098cc9c453621d3173`. Physical owned source identities match the reviews. The reviewed roles cover decorated constructor tokens, the locally owned borrowed-injector bridge and its public injection context, the public CDK column class bridge, and NgModule metadata; the source facts do not qualify complete Angular node/module behavior.

Replayed production role evaluator with v3 inputs: 13 current and one frozen roles resolve, with no new insufficiencies; targeted producer, archive, transition and root-record mutations reject. Independent physical mutations to five affected source paths reject their roles. Byte-level comparison outside the 13+1 row nodes passed. All 46 blocked removed-use rows remain unchanged and insufficient. The v3 successor to v1 changes only 14 review text strings and their corresponding reference digests; it corrects the earlier unsupported `sandboxed` wording. Both column and no-data run descriptions now say sandbox state was not directly measured for those individual runs; a separate sandbox smoke is not substituted for those measurements.

The root column record reports 288 comparisons and six mutants; the separately reviewed no-data producer report records 21 protocol cases across three models and six controls. These are bounded observations, with explicit collaborator protocols; historical producer observations remain historical data. Browser tests were not independently rerun, and these source-evidence transitions do not establish a full table, packed artifact, peer floor, production admission, security or G11 pass.
